title: Transfer: Memory-Efficient Catalog Deduper
goal: Refactor a large NDJSON product catalog normalizer so it can deduplicate records and emit canonicalized output despite heavy string repetition and sparse attributes, all within a fixed memory cap.
skillBenefitRationale: This transfer task depends on interning repeated values, compact record layouts, sparse handling, and streaming normalization instead of accumulating full object graphs, so memory optimization is the unique key skill.
